breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradictory instructions regarding the grid definition (Nx and dx). It resolved the issue by removing the entire ambiguous preamble and only including the single, correct grid specification (`dx=1/Nx` for a periodic domain with Nx points), which aligns with the ground truth's approach of eliminating the contradiction.
